Key.English: Build a faction mod: units, loadouts, vehicles and groups.
The ORBAT Creator and the ALiVE web tools.
Open the ALiVE War Room in your web browser.
Open the ALiVE Mission Builder in your web browser.
Open the ALiVE Terrain Indexer in your web browser.
Find an ALiVE server to join, in your web browser.
2 to 8 letters or digits. It starts every class name in the mod, so pick one nobody else uses.
A file in Documents\Arma 3\ALiVE\orbat\import, for Load from file
No parts to choose for this vehicle
How often ALiVE picks this group compared with the others in its category, from 0.05 (rarely) to 1 (most often). Needs Weight by rarity on the ALiVE tab.
ALiVE's placement does not draw groups from %1. Move them to another category to have them placed.
Full guide: the ORBAT Creator page (sys_orbatcreator.htm) in the ALiVE documentation.
Give the faction a Name and a Tag of 2 to 8 letters or digits. Every class in the exported mod starts with the tag, so pick one nobody else uses.
Pick the Side and a Flag. Mod folder is the name of the folder Export writes.
Save keeps the faction in your Saved factions. Load, Delete and New faction work on that list, and Restore previous brings back what you had before a Load or a New faction.
Import faction starts from a faction already in the game, or merges one into this faction.
Copy share text and Paste share text pass a faction between players. Load from file reads a .alivefaction.txt file from Documents\Arma 3\ALiVE\orbat\import (type its name without the ending).
Add opens the class browser: pick soldiers and press Add selected.
Copy, Delete, Up and Down work on the selected unit.
Name is what players see. Class name follows it while Automatic is ticked.
Pick changes the class the unit is based on: keep its loadout, or take the new class's loadout.
Edit loadout opens the Arsenal on the unit, and closing the Arsenal saves the loadout. Undo Arsenal puts the last loadout back.
Keep this face and voice writes the unit's current face and voice into the mod.
Add opens the class browser on vehicles. Copy, Delete, Up, Down, Name and Pick work as on the Units tab.
Crew is the soldier who drives and fills the seats. Gunner seats lists the turrets: pick a seat, then its Gunner.
ALiVE crews every seat from Crew alone, so set Crew to the gunner you picked if ALiVE places this vehicle.
Paint, Pylons (the base vehicle's presets) and Parts (slat armour, camo nets and the like) show on the preview and go into the mod.
Cargo, Edit sets what the vehicle carries: as the base vehicle, empty, or your own list, filled from a unit's gear or the base vehicle's cargo.
Pick an ALiVE category, then New adds a group to it. Copy and Delete work on the selected group.
Pick a unit or vehicle beside Add to group and press it. The first member leads the group.
Rank, Remove, Up and Down work on the selected member.
How often sets how often ALiVE picks the group compared with the others in its category, from 0.05 (rarely) to 1 (most often), while Weight by rarity is on in the ALiVE tab. Map icon is its marker.
ALiVE does not place Support or Mechanized (MTP) groups; the note under the list says so.
Check lists what must be fixed (red) and warnings (amber), and writes nothing.
Export mod writes the faction to Documents\Arma 3\ALiVE\orbat, in its Mod folder.
In that folder, rename rebuild.bat.txt to rebuild.bat and run it to pack the mod. It needs Arma 3 Tools from Steam.
Copy config puts the config.cpp on the clipboard. Copy path puts the folder's path there.
The mod needs CBA_A3 and the mods listed under Needs. ALiVE is not needed to play with it.
Export mod needs ALiVE Tools. If this tab shows a red warning, it says why ALiVE Tools isn't available and what to do.
ALiVE Tools isn't available, so the mod can't be exported. BattlEye blocks it: in the Arma 3 Launcher, open the BattlEye page, untick Enable BattlEye anti-cheat software and restart the game.

ALiVE Tools isn't available (error 404), so the mod can't be exported. The alive_tools files are missing from the ALiVE mod folder: reinstall or update ALiVE, and check that antivirus hasn't removed them.

ALiVE Tools isn't available (error %1), so the mod can't be exported. Check that antivirus hasn't blocked the alive_tools files in the ALiVE mod folder, and reinstall or update ALiVE if the error stays.
%1 shown of %2. Type in Search or pick a faction to see the rest.

Always apply the loadout, even when something changed the unit first. Without it, a mission keeps the gear it gives a soldier, unless it changed only his headgear or facewear (the game picks those at random).
No mod folder yet. Set one on the Faction tab.

The 3D preview: hold the left mouse button and drag to move the view, hold the right button and drag to turn around the unit, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out. The view stays where you put it while you change the same unit or vehicle; double-click the preview to frame it again.

Makes the groups ALiVE draws from (fireteams, squads, motor patrols, armour, batteries, aircraft, boats) out of the faction's men and vehicles. Only missing ones are added; your own groups are never touched.

Declare to ALiVE writes a block that tells ALiVE about the faction, so a mission needs no script. The mod still runs without ALiVE.
Crates and lists are worked out from your men and vehicles. Changing one keeps it as you set it; Back to automatic undoes that.

%1 is ticked Optional, but it needs no mod the rest of the faction does not, so it is written in the main part.
